summary: A member holding the floor sends an aide to the desk for advice without interrupting the speech.
realLife: Riddick recalled aides taking questions from senators during long speeches and carrying the desk’s written answers back to them.
inGame: needs: recognized speaker, aide and pending floor question.

turns.what: The aide returns to the speaker for clarification.
turns.writesBack: The desk answers the revised inquiry.

turns.what: The aide brings back the ruling.
turns.pulledBy: The chair resolves the point first.
turns.writesBack: The speaker adjusts the next sentence.
